text:
marc-partners: Heads up — HeliosRack routed a PO (HR-9012) through marketplace but it failed validation. They added an "installation acceptance" clause in the PO body that our portal can't represent: they want Redwood to sign off on on-site acceptance checklist before invoice.
dina-procure: portal error: `Invalid PO field: acceptance_clause (unsupported)` — partner is insisting acceptance prevents invoicing until on-site sign-off. Procurement can't close the PO without a mapped field.
anya-ops: opened integrator ticket INT-2293 to see if we can map a conditional flag. Also pinged marketplace-engineering.
marketplace_bot: INT-2293 created and assigned to marketplace-data-model. SLA initial reply 6h.
nate-legal: that clause effectively turns our revenue recognition into a contingent event tied to partner's install team. We need to avoid language that makes Redwood assume installation liability or acceptance obligations. Proposed redline: change from "Redwood shall sign acceptance" to "Customer acceptance to be confirmed between Partner and Customer; Redwood may require evidence for billing." 
ria-sales: HeliosRack says the clause is their standard for large racks — they want to prevent chargebacks. Sales wants to keep this in-marketplace for reporting; partner prefers direct SOW if we can't accept the field.
tori-eng: ops note — field-level support is non-trivial because acceptance is region-specific (third-party installers vary) and could add a boolean plus PDF attachment flow. That will impact UI and API.
marc-partners: quick asks: (1) can we do a temporary "acceptance-flag" metadata tag in the portal so PO can go thru but invoice is held (owner: anya-ops, due: 2026-04-01 09:00 PT) (2) nate-legal to propose carrier-neutral wording that keeps billing decoupled from install acceptance (owner: nate-legal, due: 2026-04-01 12:00 PT) (3) ria-sales to confirm HeliosRack will accept a metadata-tag reservation or else request direct SOW (owner: ria-sales, due: 2026-03-31 COB)
anya-ops: quick workaround idea — tag PO status "pending-install-acceptance" which blocks invoice generation but allows PO to be recorded. Finance will need manual hold. I can draft the runbook.
dina-procure: finance impact — we need to map "pending-install-acceptance" to deferred revenue mapping in billing system. Will need a reconciliation ticket and clear owner for when acceptance is received.
nate-legal: drafted clause suggestion: "Billing may be deferred pending partner-provided acceptance evidence; Redwood retains no affirmative installation acceptance obligations and may rely on third-party attestations for invoicing." I'll share redline with Helios counsel.
ria-sales: update from AM: HeliosRack will accept metadata tag for NA but APAC insists on acceptance clause due to local customs invoicing rules. So we'll need per-region handling again.
anya-ops: noted per-region branching; will include conditional flow in runbook and a checklist for required attestation documents by region.
tori-eng: compatibility note — attaching large PDF acceptance docs will spike storage and change validation. Recommend limiting to a single signed attestation URL or hash rather than full binary upload.
marc-partners: decision path: if marketplace can support metadata tag + legal redline accepts partner attestation, proceed in-portal for NA. If APAC/EMEA require hard clause, escalate to partner request for direct SOW. Meeting if unresolved tomorrow 08:30 PT.
marketplace_bot: Reminder: INT-2293 assigned to marketplace-data-model. Next status update scheduled in 6h.
marc-partners: thanks team — keep me posted and cc me if HeliosRack counsel pushes additional language. :raised_hands:
